reason: judged the change against the issue: 7 requirement(s) not met or not sure

unmet: RQADM-2: ADR-009's "Enforced by" section names tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh, but that file does not exist in the repository. scripts/lib/lint-adr-enforced-by.sh checks every path named in an Enforced by section and exits non-zero when the file is absent — the lint step will fail. — docs/adr/ADR-009-platform-aware-modularity.md | tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh

RQPRO-1: The issue requires a test that fails on the old code and passes now. No such test exists; tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh is not present. No assertion in the test suite exercises zbuild_sed_inplace with ZBUILD_PLATFORM set to a wrong value. Putting the old ZBUILD_PLATFORM-based branch back would not turn any test red. — zbuild_sed_inplace picks its sed -i form from a probe run once when the file loads, not from a platform name

RQPRO-2: No test sets ZBUILD_PLATFORM to a wrong value and verifies _zb_target_mode_v still returns a valid octal mode. tests/unit/platform-probe-test.sh does not exist. Reverting to the ZBUILD_PLATFORM branch would not turn any test red. — _zb_target_mode_v picks its stat form from a probe run once when the file loads, not from a platform name

RQWRK-1: No test sources either library with ZBUILD_PLATFORM=ios (or any wrong value) and calls both functions to verify they still produce correct output. The acceptance check explicitly recorded this gap. — With ZBUILD_PLATFORM set to a wrong value (e.g. ios), both functions still work on the host

RQPRO-3: The issue requires a test that confirms the probe variable encodes the GNU -c form when stat -c '%a' succeeds on the host. No test inspects _ZB_STAT_MODE_CMD after sourcing helpers.sh. Reverting the probe to try BSD first would not turn any test red. — Use the GNU form first (stat -c before stat -f)

RQSTT-1: The issue requires a test showing each mode check runs exactly one stat. tests/unit/atomic-write-cost-test.sh W1 asserts one stat per atomic_write on a Linux CI host, but on Linux the old code also ran one stat (the stat -c branch returned a valid mode and the fallback never triggered), so this test does not distinguish old from new. No test covers the scenario that set ZBUILD_PLATFORM=macos on Linux with the old code, triggering two stats. — The probe replaces _zb_target_mode_v's second stat call so each mode check runs one stat

RQDEL-1: zbuild_stat_size is absent from scripts/lib/compat.sh, which is correct. However no test verifies declare -f zbuild_stat_size exits non-zero after sourcing the file. Adding the function back would not turn any test red. — zbuild_stat_size is deleted
